description: This file is a React-based JavaScript source code for the front-end of a Decision Helper application. It manages multiple decisions, each with criteria, options, scoring, rankings, and visualization components. The code includes functions for state management, calculation of scores and rankings, sensitivity analysis, and UI rendering.

methods.name: uid()
methods.description: Generates a reasonably unique ID for client-side entities using timestamp and random values.

methods.name: clamp(n, min, max)
methods.description: Clamps a number to a specified min and max range.

methods.name: toNumber(value, fallback = 0)
methods.description: Converts a value to a finite number, with a fallback default.

methods.name: normalizeWeights(criteria)
methods.description: Calculates normalized weights for criteria, dividing each weight by the sum of all weights.

methods.name: computeTotals(decision)
methods.description: Computes total scores for options based on criteria weights and scores.

methods.name: rankOptions(decision)
methods.description: Ranks options descending by their total scores, with tie-breaker by name.

methods.name: applyWeightOverrides(decision, overridesByCriterionId)
methods.description: Creates a copy of a decision with specific criteria weights overridden for sensitivity analysis.

methods.name: computeSensitivityOneCriterion(decision, criterionId, step = 1)
methods.description: Performs sensitivity analysis by varying one criterion's weight across a range and observing rank changes.

methods.name: createDecision(name = "New Decision")
methods.description: Creates a starter decision object with default criteria, options, and scores.

methods.name: loadState()
methods.description: Loads and validates persisted app state from local storage.

methods.name: saveState(state)
methods.description: Saves current app state to local storage.

methods.name: BarChart({ rows, maxValue = 100 })
methods.description: Renders a simple inline SVG horizontal bar chart for visualizing rankings.

methods.name: EmptyState({ title, description, action })
methods.description: UI component indicating an empty or default state, with optional action.

methods.name: Modal({ title, children, onClose, footer })
methods.description: Reusable modal dialog component for forms and content overlays.
